summary: The five 'narrative' workflows (nomination, selection-publish, vote, meeting-RSVP, discussion-message) carry genuinely good product copy — real titles like 'Parable of the Sower', 'Octavia E. Butler - February reading cycle.', 'Thu, Feb 15 at 7:00 PM - Maya's living room.', 'Closes Jan 20', '10 of 14 spots' — and their action sheets are the strongest screens in the set. Three problems block a pass: the reading-material and shared-library-item workflows are still generic scaffolding ('Task details', 'State saved', 'Reading material opened.', and an ad-network CTA reading 'Ad preference and sponsored-message beh…' / 'Open ad details' inside a book club), several 'start' captures are scrolled onto the wrong surface entirely (export-metadata start shows the Discussion thread card, meeting-RSVP start shows the AI reading-guide card), and every 'complete' screen prints the same confirmation sentence three times in a row down the page. Layout clipping is pervasive: hero headings are sliced mid-line at the top of six screens and the bottom-nav 'Library' pill runs off the right edge. 12 of 27 screens fail.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Across this community's workflows, is it always clear what workflow and what state (start/in-progress/complete) the user is looking at?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Not consistently. Where the copy is written (nomination, vote, publish, RSVP, discussion) state is very legible without any account concept — the action sheets name themselves in the app bar ('Cast book vote', 'Book meeting RSVP', 'Reply to discussion') and the complete states say 'Vote saved', 'Selection published', 'RSVP confirmed', 'Reply sent'. But three start captures do not show the workflow they claim: 'book-export-metadata_start' shows a purple 'Discussion thread / Prompt: What does community care require?' card with a 'Waiting' chip and no export surface at all, and 'book-meeting-rsvp_start' shows the 'Knowledge and search' / 'Reading guide answer' block with only a clipped 'RSVP to event' button peeking above the fold. The reading-material and library-item workflows are legible as states ('State saved', 'Saved') but not as content — 'Reading material opened.' and 'Shared library custody state updated.' never say which guide or which item.

book-meeting-rsvp_start is scrolled to 'Knowledge and search — Cited answers, source visibility, and saved digests.' with the RSVP row sliced to 'Expand | RSVP to event' at the very top edge
book-reading-material_complete states only 'Saved details — Reading material opened.' and repeats 'Reading material opened.' twice more, never naming a guide, chapter, or book

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does displayed text read like real Neighborhood Book Club product copy, or like placeholder scaffolding?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Split down the middle. Real copy exists and is good: 'Parable of the Sower is on the February ballot with title, author, rationale, and meeting context.', 'Focus the chapter 6 discussion on mutual aid, scarcity, and Lauren's journal voice.', 'Checksum BC-042 and export timestamp are written to the owner audit history.', 'Maya's living room', '10 of 14 spots'. Against that, the reading-material and shared-library-item workflows show copy from a different product domain entirely — 'Ad preference and sponsored-message beh…' with an 'Open ad details' button — plus framework-level headings 'Task details', 'Saved details', 'Activity details', 'Local package details', and chip labels that describe the harness rather than the club: 'Details ready', 'Editable', 'State saved'. Several instructional strings are also visibly internal spec text: 'This view shows editable details, current progress, and the next step before saving.' appears verbatim on eight screens.
visibleEvidence: book-library-item_start and book-reading-material_start both show a card titled 'Reading material' whose body is 'Ad preference and sponsored-message beh…' with the action 'Open ad details'
book-reading-material_action makes 'Open ad details' the filled primary teal CTA under a heading 'Task details' on a screen whose app bar reads 'Reading material'
The string 'This view shows editable details, current progress, and the next step before saving.' is repeated verbatim on the nomination, vote, RSVP, reading-material and library-item screens

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the visual execution production-grade — no repeated shells, thin content, clipping or crowding?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: No. Two systemic defects repeat across the set. First, every 'complete' screen prints its confirmation sentence three times: on book-vote_complete, 'Your vote for Parable of the Sower is confirmed, status is saved, and it can be changed before the ballot closes.' appears as the hero body, again inside 'Vote saved', and again inside 'Vote confirmed' — the same triple-print occurs on the nomination, selection-publish, RSVP, discussion and library complete screens. Second, top-of-frame clipping: book-nomination_start opens on a sliced word 'cycle.', book-vote_start on a half-cut line 'Parable of the Sower is leading the', book-library-item_start on a half-cut 'Members can borrow, queue for, return,'. The bottom navigation's 'Library' pill is cut off by the right screen edge on at least five screens. book-library-item_start also leaves roughly the bottom third of the screen as bare dark-green background under a collapsed 'Local package details' row.
visibleEvidence: book-vote_complete shows the identical sentence 'Your vote for Parable of the Sower is confirmed, status is saved, and it can be changed before the ballot closes.' three times in one scroll
book-nomination_start's first visible text is the sliced descender word 'cycle.' with the line above cut off by the teal app bar
The 'Library' bottom-nav pill is clipped at the right screen edge on book-nomination_start, book-vote_start, book-discussion-message_start and book-meeting-rsvp_start

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Are available actions clear, and is it clear why disabled or hidden ones are unavailable?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Partly. Primary CTAs are unambiguous and well labelled — 'Submit nomination', 'Record vote', 'Publish announcement', 'RSVP to event', 'Send message'. Two problems recur. Background cards show a pill literally reading 'Not available' with a slash icon, explained only by 'Another community role manages this item.' — that names no role and offers no path, so the user cannot tell what would unlock it. And every action sheet duplicates its secondary action twice: 'Edit nomination' appears as an outlined button mid-card and again as a dark-green ghost link at the card's bottom-right that renders at very low contrast against the near-black card ('Edit nomination', 'Save draft', 'Change vote', 'Change response', 'Archive thread', 'Edit details' all do this). On book-search-ai-digest_action a card titled 'Answer actions' promises 'Open cited sources, save the answer, refine the query, or share it with members' but renders no buttons at all — only prose bullets.

book-search-ai-digest_action's 'Answer actions' card lists 'Open cited sources, save the answer, refine the query, or share it with members.' but shows no tappable controls

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does what each screen shows make sense for the workflow being demonstrated?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Mostly yes for the authored workflows — an organizer-flavoured publish screen ('From organizer', 'Audience: members'), a member-flavoured vote screen ('Your vote will count once for Parable of the Sower'), and an owner-flavoured export screen ('Owner can download the archive after checksum verification succeeds.') are each internally coherent, and the flat-schema absence of a signed-in identity is not a problem. The scoping failures are content ones: an advertising-preferences surface surfaced inside the club's reading-material slot, and two start captures parked on a different workflow's card than the row claims.

findings.title: Export-metadata start state shows the discussion thread, not the export surface
findings.description: The screen evidencing the export workflow's start state contains no export surface at all. The in-focus card is a purple 'Discussion thread' with 'Prompt: What does community care require?', chips 'From Jordan', 'Members only', '3 unread', 'Club scoped', and an unexplained 'Waiting' pill, under a 'Messages and connections' band. No scope selection, redaction option, destination, checksum, or generate action is visible. The meeting-RSVP start screen has the same defect in reverse — it is parked on the 'Knowledge and search' / 'Answer with sources' surface with only a sliced 'RSVP to event' button at the top edge.
findings.requiredFix: Capture each start state with that workflow's own card scrolled fully into frame — the export package card with its scope/redaction/destination controls, and the RSVP card with 'Parable discussion night', Thu Feb 15, 7:00 PM, Maya's living room and 10 of 14 spots visible.

findings.title: Advertising-preference copy and an 'Open ad details' CTA appear inside the reading-material workflow
findings.description: The 'Reading material' card renders body text from an advertising product — 'Ad preference and sponsored-message beh…' — with a button labelled 'Open ad details', on the reading-material start, the library-item start, and again as the filled teal primary CTA on the reading-material action sheet whose app bar reads 'Reading material'. A neighborhood book club has no ad preferences; this is content leaked in from an unrelated surface and it makes the most prominent control on the action screen contradict the screen's own title.
findings.requiredFix: Replace the ad-preference copy and 'Open ad details' action with reading-guide content — the guide's book and chapter range, author links, discussion prompts — and an 'Open reading guide' primary action.

findings.title: Shared-library and reading-material workflows show framework scaffolding instead of club content
findings.description: Across all six screens of these two workflows the only content is generic: headings 'Task details', 'Saved details', 'Activity details'; chips 'Details ready', 'Editable', 'State saved'; a CTA that names its own component, 'Start shared library item'; and completion payloads of one sentence each — 'Reading material opened.' and 'Shared library custody state updated.' — the latter using internal data-model vocabulary. No item title, holder, queue position, due date, guide name, chapter, or timestamp appears anywhere. The library-item action sheet uses the same generic sentence in its subtitle, body, and Task details card.
findings.requiredFix: Author real content for both workflows to the standard the vote and RSVP screens already meet: name the item and its custody ('Maya has the club copy until Feb 22, 2 members queued') and the guide and its scope, and replace 'Start shared library item' with 'Borrow', 'Join queue', or 'Return'.

findings.title: Every complete state prints its confirmation sentence three times
findings.description: On each complete screen the same sentence appears as the hero body, again inside a record card, and a third time in the trailing confirmation strip. Examples: 'Your vote for Parable of the Sower is confirmed, status is saved, and it can be changed before the ballot closes.' (hero / 'Vote saved' / 'Vote confirmed'); 'You are going to the Parable discussion; seat count, reminder, and change response stay visible.' (hero / 'Response options' / 'RSVP confirmed'); 'Your discussion message is posted to the Parable thread with sender and member scope.' (hero / 'Conversation record' / 'Reply sent'). The secondary action is likewise duplicated ('Change vote', 'Change response', 'Archive thread', 'Edit nomination', 'Save draft'), with the second copy rendered as a low-contrast green ghost link at the card's bottom-right that is barely readable on the dark card.
findings.requiredFix: State the outcome once and let subsequent cards add new information (timestamp, resulting record, next step). Render each secondary action once, at a contrast ratio readable against the card background.

findings.title: Published announcement still offers 'Save draft' and pre-publish copy
findings.description: The selection-publish complete screen states 'Members received the February selection announcement with book, sender, timing, and next steps.' and shows a 'Selection published' strip, yet between them it retains the pre-send line 'Message body, audience, delivery timing, preview, and draft option stay visible before publishing.' with an active 'Save draft' button, and offers a second 'Save draft' inside 'Member inbox result'. 'Today 5:00 PM' also still reads as a scheduled future slot after delivery. Offering to draft an already-delivered announcement is a wrong-state action that could make an organizer doubt whether the send occurred.
findings.requiredFix: Remove draft controls and pre-publish instructional copy from the published state; show delivery timestamp and reach, with post-send actions such as 'View in inbox' or 'Resend'.

findings.title: Hero cards sliced mid-sentence at the top of frame and the 'Library' nav pill runs off the right edge
findings.description: Six screens open on a cut-off line rather than a card top: 'cycle.' on nomination start, 'Parable of the Sower is leading the' on vote start, 'Reply to the Parable discussion with a note scoped to club members.' on discussion start, 'and claim shared items.' on library start, 'Expand | RSVP to event' on RSVP start, and two label-less button outlines on export start. Separately, the bottom navigation row overflows horizontally so the 'Library' pill is cut by the right screen edge on nomination start, vote start, discussion start and RSVP start. Trailing confirmation strips ('Nomination submitted', 'Selection published', 'RSVP confirmed', 'Reply sent', 'Book archive generated', 'Saved answer') are also each clipped mid-sentence by the bottom nav.
findings.requiredFix: Anchor each capture so the focused card's title is fully visible below the app bar, add bottom padding so trailing confirmation strips clear the nav, and fix the bottom nav so all four tabs fit within the screen width.

findings.title: Repeated generic card shells with unexplained 'Not available' actions
findings.description: Background cards repeat an identical shell — icon, 'Minimized' pill, 'Tap for expanded view', 'Member form', 'Expand', trailing action — differing only by title. On vote start, 'Shared library item' and 'Reading material' are visually identical and both read 'Another community role manages this item.' with a disabled 'Not available' pill that names no role and offers no path. On discussion start, 'Book nomination' and 'Book vote' both carry the same truncated description 'Member form captures labeled details, privacy c…'. A debug affordance, 'In-focus product surface … Expand', is also visible on three screens.
findings.requiredFix: Give each background card its own real summary content, replace 'Not available' with a reason naming the responsible role and any available next step, and remove the 'In-focus product surface' debug strip from production surfaces.

findings.title: Several cards describe affordances in prose rather than rendering them
findings.description: The AI-digest action sheet's 'Answer actions' card promises 'Open cited sources, save the answer, refine the query, or share it with members.' but contains no tappable controls, and one of its bullets is written about the user in third person: 'The user sees the query, answer, citations, source visibility, and follow-up options.' The same sheet duplicates the whole 'Answer summary / Source snippets / Citation detail' block twice on one screen. Similarly, the export action sheet says 'Scope, redaction, checksum, destination, transfer status, rollback, and audit evidence are visible' with no controls in frame; the RSVP sheet says 'Going/Maybe/Not going options are visible' but renders one generic 'RSVP to event' button; the discussion sheet lists eleven options ('reply, send, accept, decline, mute, archive, and block…') but renders only 'Archive thread'; and the publish sheet promises a body preview whose card is clipped off-screen.
findings.requiredFix: Render the described controls as real controls — distinct Going/Maybe/Not going options, citation rows that open sources, export scope and redaction toggles — and delete spec-voice bullets that narrate what 'the user sees'.

findings.title: Counts and chips do not change between action and complete states
findings.description: The vote complete screen still shows '1 member vote' after the member records a vote, and the RSVP complete screen still shows '10 of 14 spots' after confirming Going, even though the action sheet stated 'Going reserves a seat and sends a reminder.' The discussion complete screen still shows '3 unread' after the reply is posted, and the export complete screen re-renders the same five numbered steps as the action screen with none marked done. The completion text asserts a change the visible data contradicts.
findings.requiredFix: Recompute chips and counters for the completed state — increment the vote tally and seat count, clear or decrement unread, and mark completed export steps — so the data corroborates the confirmation copy.

findings.title: Internal 'before saving' instructional text persists into saved and published states
findings.description: The string 'This view shows editable details, current progress, and the next step before saving.' appears verbatim on the nomination, vote, RSVP, reading-material and library-item screens, including on complete states where the save has already happened, paired with an 'Edit response' or 'Edit nomination' button. Chip labels like 'Details ready', 'Editable', 'State saved' and 'Book title entered' / 'Author confirmed' similarly report harness status rather than club data — the latter two are redundant when the title and author are printed two lines above them.
findings.requiredFix: Remove the pre-save instructional band from completed states, and replace status-report chips with the values they refer to (the entered title, the confirmed author, the saved timestamp).
